structural_change: hnx_rp4lp4 (HBM-NEXT-SM4 10-19) = rp4lp (PL-SMT 2444d768c, landed regions n / s) with P = 4 lanes per leaf: 2 leaves x 4 lane units (each the closed x store + block-dot column + tct + 2 tcl) = 40 leaf hard children + the 8 rp4lp transport children; outline 889.92 x 2160.0 (2 x 2 lane units per leaf, compact 2-D middle band); per-lane kept fan-out registers (+1), lane-select x-write beats (zero beat one-hot), slot-major publish (lane p +p*8, collision = fault). Ports unchanged.
